pz257sfm.variantName: COSTWAY 6FT Pre-lit Snow Flocked Christmas Tree With Lights-White
pz257sfm.sourceDescription: The Christmas tree is pre-lit with warm white LED lights, featuring 8 customizable lighting effects: combination, in wave, sequential, slow glow, chasing/flash, slow fade, twinkle/flash, and steady on. For a more lifelike appearance, this slim pencil tree is designed with snowy branch tips made from premium flame-retardant PE & PVC, creating a lush and realistic fir look. Assembly is simple thanks to 2 detachable trunk sections and a foldable metal stand with a pre-installed bolt. Gloves are included to help protect your hands during setup. Ideal for adding festive charm, these slim Christmas trees serve as a vivid and classic centerpiece for homes, apartments, storefronts, or offices. Note: Ornaments are not included! A little flocking may shed during first setup, gentle handling works best! Adjustable Light Modes: The pre-lit Christmas tree is equipped with warm white LED lights to create a bright holiday atmosphere. With 8 lighting modes, including slow fade, flashing, and sequential modes, it is easy to adjust the display to match different celebrations or personal decorating styles. Gorgeous Snowy Look: Designed with branch tips, the pre-lit holiday tree presents a lush and lifelike shape. The snow-flocked leaves paired with hidden snowy wires enhance the seasonal look, filling your room with a charming winter touch. 100% New PE & PVC Materials: Made from 100% new PE & PVC materials, the tree leaves are smell-less and flame-retardant for added peace of mind during use. The selected material also resists fading, allowing the artificial Xmas tree to maintain its fresh and beautiful appearance over time. Convenient Setup & Storage: The metal stand comes with a pre-attached bolt to help speed up installation and ensure precise alignment. Included gloves offer extra protection while arranging the branches. Plus, the foldable stand and 2-section trunk make it easy to take apart and store after the holidays. Suitable for Various Settings: With its slim pencil profile, the Christmas tree fits neatly into living rooms, apartments, offices, and corners without taking up too much space. Whether used for seasonal decorating, family gatherings, or holiday parties, it adds a lively and festive accent to any indoor environment.
